acne.name: Neem & Turmeric Purifying Face Wash
acne.description: A powerful Ayurvedic face wash infused with pure neem leaf extract and wild turmeric root. Eliminates acne-causing bacteria, unclogs pores, and leaves skin visibly clearer within 7 days.
benefits: Reduces inflammation and redness in 3 days
acne.how_to_use: Wet face. Apply a small amount and massage in circular motions for 60 seconds. Rinse thoroughly. Use twice daily.

acne.name: Tea Tree Spot Correction Serum
acne.description: A concentrated herbal serum with pure tea tree oil and willow bark extract. Targets active pimples, fades dark spots, and regulates sebum production for long-lasting clarity.
benefits: Rapid spot treatment — works in 8 hours
acne.how_to_use: Apply 2-3 drops directly on affected areas after cleansing. Use nightly. Avoid the eye area.

acne.name: Aloe & Neem Clarifying Toner
acne.description: A balancing herbal toner with organic aloe vera and neem extract. Removes residual impurities, tightens pores, and prepares skin for better serum absorption.
benefits: Removes last traces of dirt and oil
Preps skin for optimal serum absorption
acne.how_to_use: After cleansing, soak a cotton pad and sweep gently across face and neck. Do not rinse. Follow with serum or moisturizer.

oily.name: Multani Mitti Oil-Control Face Pack
oily.description: A traditional Ayurvedic clay mask with multani mitti and sandalwood powder. Deeply absorbs excess oil, tightens pores, and leaves skin beautifully matte for 8+ hours.
benefits: Absorbs 3x more oil than regular clay masks
oily.how_to_use: Mix with rose water to a smooth paste. Apply evenly on face. Leave for 15 minutes. Rinse off with cool water. Use twice a week.

oily.name: Green Tea Mattifying Moisturizer
oily.description: An ultra-lightweight gel moisturizer with green tea antioxidants and zinc PCA. Hydrates oily skin without adding grease and controls sebum production.
benefits: Antioxidants fight pollution and UV damage
oily.how_to_use: Apply a pea-sized amount on cleansed face. Massage gently until absorbed. Use morning and evening.

oily.name: Lemon & Honey Pore Minimizing Scrub
oily.description: A natural exfoliating scrub with lemon peel powder and raw honey that removes dead skin cells, clears clogged pores, and brightens dull oily skin with every use.
oily.how_to_use: Apply on damp face in circular motions. Focus on nose and forehead. Rinse after 5 minutes. Use 2-3 times a week.

normal.name: Rose & Sandalwood Glow Cleanser
normal.description: A luxury Ayurvedic gel cleanser with pure Bulgarian rose water and red sandalwood extract. Gently removes impurities while maintaining normal skin's perfect balance and natural radiance.
benefits: Mild and gentle — safe for twice-daily use
Natural Vitamin C brightens skin tone
normal.how_to_use: Lather in palms with water. Massage on wet face for 30 seconds. Rinse. Ideal for morning and evening.

normal.name: Cucumber & Honey Hydrating Mist
normal.description: A refreshing facial mist with cold-pressed cucumber juice and mountain honey. Instantly rehydrates, soothes tired skin, and locks in moisture throughout the day.
benefits: Instantly cools and refreshes tired skin
Use anytime — over makeup or bare skin
normal.how_to_use: Close eyes and mist 20-30cm from face. Pat gently to absorb. Use anytime throughout the day.

normal.name: Coconut & Vitamin E Night Cream
normal.description: A rich overnight repair cream with virgin coconut oil and Vitamin E. Works while you sleep to deeply nourish, repair daily damage, and reveal softer, glowing skin every morning.
benefits: Repairs daily skin damage while you sleep
Deep nourishment for soft, supple skin
Reduces fine lines and dullness overnight
normal.how_to_use: Apply a small amount on cleansed face and neck before bed. Massage gently in upward motions. Leave overnight.
